results.question: can I quit a class after the drop deadline and get my fees back
results.answer:
Welcome to Hammered University! 

No, you cannot get your fees back if you quit (withdraw) after the add/drop deadline [c-fdfddfcd1e74248c]. 

According to our policies:
* **Dropping** a course by the add/drop deadline (22 January 2027 at 17:00) results in a full tuition refund and no transcript entry [c-d7a84592ad0a187b][c-fdfddfcd1e74248c].
* **Withdrawing** after the add/drop deadline but by the withdrawal deadline (26 February 2027 at 17:00) results in a "W" on your transcript, but **no tuition refund** [c-d7a84592ad0a187b][c-fdfddfcd1e74248c]. 
* After the withdrawal deadline, ordinary withdrawal is unavailable, and exceptional circumstances require registrar review without published approval criteria or guaranteed exceptions [c-07236b5548b48a9c].
